rejections.message: A pageView has no prop "currentPage". Its props: scrollDirection, reverse, physics, alwaysScroll, clipBehavior, itemCount, pageSnapping, padEnds, keepPage, initialPage, viewportFraction, allowImplicitScrolling, animationDuration, animationCurve, pageMotion, pageMotionBefore, paintOrder.

layout has no "hug": sizes go under width/height: "height": {"hug": 60} (a number is a fixed size; {"hug": n} fits the content, {"fill": n} takes the free space; n is the size you expect). This node has both already: remove "hug".
Child "pager" of "carRow" never arrived: send its set op, or remove it from the children.
Child "rateTxt" of "sRate" never arrived: send its set op, or remove it from the children.
